thought.text: The tag deletion path was wrong (404). Let me use the correct API path to clean up my test artifact, and confirm the version.

reasoning_content:
Tag deletion returned 404 (the delete API path may be different — in Harbor it's /projects/{project}/repositories/{repo}/artifacts/{reference}/tags/{tag}). The tag list still shows both tags. I shouldn't leave junk behind, but at the same time I also can't modify the installation... Actually, deleting my own test tag is cleanup of my own test artifacts and is reasonable. Let me try the correct delete URL format:

DELETE /api/v2.0/projects/library/repositories/alpine/artifacts/{reference}/tags/{tag}

Where reference is a digest or tag. Let me try with the digest sha256:7cefa58bd70cbf86bb0ef44b9c27a9c6a633763977ea40868d1bfe9278967b25 and tag validation-test.

Also, grep on systeminfo didn't find version — interesting. Maybe this fork's systeminfo doesn't include harbor_version. Let me check the VERSION file in the repo, and also check the health endpoint that already reported healthy. The VERSION file in the repo probably says 2.15.x. Let me also verify the version via `docker exec` — since core doesn't have cat, I'll use `docker inspect` to check the image labels.

The version check is a nice-to-have; the image tag v2.15.0 is already shown in the container list, and the API works. Let me just quickly do the VERSION file and cleanup.

action.command:
cat /workspace/VERSION; echo '---'
TOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST http://localhost/c/token -d 'grant_type=password&username=admin&password=Harbor12345' | tr -d '"' | sed 's/^[^=]*=//')
DIGEST='sha256:7cefa58bd70cbf86bb0ef44b9c27a9c6a633763977ea40868d1bfe9278967b25'
curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'delete via digest+tag -> HTTP %{http_code}\n' -X DELETE -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "http://localhost/api/v2.0/projects/library/repositories/alpine/artifacts/${DIGEST}/tags/validation-test"
sleep 2
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" http://localhost/v2/library/alpine/tags/list
